company.name: Lawyaw
company.shortDescription: Lawyaw is a computational linguistics company building tools for lawyers.
company.description:
Lawyaw is a computational linguistics company building tools for lawyers. It is building innovative natural language processing systems to push the boundaries and discover new computational and mathematical properties of language. Its mission is to build the most intelligent, powerful, and intuitive legal document automation platform in the world.

The company was founded in 2016 and is based in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based legal document automation platform that converts Word documents into reusable templates and provides access to fillable court forms, enabling law firms to automate drafting, information gathering, and e-signature processes.
productsAndServices.name: Clio Draft

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based service providing access to thousands of fillable, up-to-date court forms for all 50 U.S. states, allowing law firms to autofill and manage court documents efficiently.
productsAndServices.name: PDF Court Forms Automation

productsAndServices.description: A tool within Clio Draft that transforms Microsoft Word legal documents into customizable, reusable templates with conditional logic to automate drafting and reduce errors.
productsAndServices.name: MS Word Document Automation

productsAndServices.description: An integrated electronic signature feature within Clio Draft that enables law firms to send, review, and collect signatures on legal documents remotely with audit trails.
productsAndServices.name: e-Signature Integration

productsAndServices.description: Professional services offered to help law firms build, optimize, and implement document automation templates and workflows tailored to their specific needs.
productsAndServices.name: Template Services
